_source: CPR core equipment, imported from the book with page cites per item (p.97, p.101-102, p.149-150, p.183-184, p.227-230, p.338-358). Numbers and short paraphrases only. fx: machine-readable effects; the vocabulary is in fx_keys (and src/core uses only the keys it implements; see docs/rules/gear.md). unmodelled: what fx doesn't capture yet.
price_tiers: Price categories (CPR core p.385): Cheap 10eb, Everyday 20eb, Costly 50eb, Premium 100eb, Expensive 500eb, Very Expensive 1,000eb, Luxury 5,000eb, Super Luxury 10,000eb and up. Without a Fixer/Night Market only up to Premium is buyable.

attachment_rules.shared_location: Attachments occupying the same physical spot can be combined, but each pays its own slot cost.
attachment_rules.clip_limit: Only one magazine attachment (extended or drum) per weapon.
attachment_rules.cross_type: Attachments are built for one weapon type; buying one fits that type only.

ammo_rules.non_basic_ok_for: Non-exotic ranged weapons; exotic weapons only Basic unless noted (p95, p347)
ammo_rules.one_type_per_magazine: Reload fills with one ammo type; no mixing (p169-170)

bayonet.name: Bayonet
bayonet.summary: Blade under the barrel; the gun doubles as a Light Melee Weapon. No longer concealable.

drum_magazine.name: Drum Magazine
drum_magazine.summary: Huge magazine; capacity from the Drum column of the Clip Chart. Not concealable. Only one magazine attachment per weapon.

extended_magazine.name: Extended Magazine
extended_magazine.summary: Larger magazine; capacity from the Extended column of the Clip Chart. Not concealable. Only one magazine attachment per weapon.

grenade_launcher_underbarrel.name: Grenade Launcher Underbarrel
grenade_launcher_underbarrel.summary: Held two-handed, the weapon can also fire as a Grenade Launcher holding one grenade. Not concealable.

infrared_nightvision_scope.name: Infrared Nightvision Scope
infrared_nightvision_scope.summary: Cuts penalties for shooting targets obscured by darkness, smoke or fog to 0; shows heat signatures only, no fine detail.
infrared_nightvision_scope.unmodelled: Thermal view distinguishes warm bodies from cold metal but reveals no identifying detail (flavour).

shotgun_underbarrel.name: Shotgun Underbarrel
shotgun_underbarrel.summary: Held two-handed, the weapon can also fire as a Shotgun with a two-shot magazine. Not concealable.

smartgun_link.name: Smartgun Link
smartgun_link.summary: Smartgun: +1 to Ranged Attacks when linked via Interface Plugs or Subdermal Grip (both need a Neural Link). Fitting takes an hour.
smartgun_link.unmodelled: Plugs connect as part of drawing into a free hand if not already in use; Subdermal Grip links automatically; disarm unplugs, replug is free while held.

sniping_scope.name: Sniping Scope
sniping_scope.summary: See detail to 800 m. +1 to single-shot or Aimed Shot attacks at targets 51 m or more away. Doesn't stack with TeleOptics.

basic_ammo.name: Basic Ammunition
basic_ammo.summary: Standard rounds, no special features. Basic arrows can be recovered after firing.
basic_ammo.unit: 10 rounds (bullets, arrows, shotgun shells); 1 each (grenades, rockets)
basic_ammo.unmodelled: Basic arrows are always retrievable after firing (p174); grenades and rockets have no Basic type (p94).

armor_piercing_ammo.name: Armor-Piercing Ammunition
armor_piercing_ammo.summary: Each ablation strips 2 SP from the target's armour instead of 1.
armor_piercing_ammo.unit: 10 rounds (bullets, arrows, shotgun shells); 1 each (grenades, rockets)

biotoxin_ammo.name: Biotoxin Ammunition
biotoxin_ammo.summary: No damage. Organic targets hit roll Resist Torture/Drugs DV15 or take 3d6 straight to HP; armour untouched.
biotoxin_ammo.unit: 10 rounds (bullets, arrows, shotgun shells); 1 each (grenades, rockets)

emp_ammo.name: EMP Ammunition
emp_ammo.summary: No damage. Targets hit roll Cybertech DV15 or 2 GM-picked cyberware/electronics stop working for a minute.
emp_ammo.unit: 10 rounds (bullets, arrows, shotgun shells); 1 each (grenades, rockets)
emp_ammo.unmodelled: Disabled cyberlimbs behave like dismembered limbs (p187) while still attached; which items are picked is a GM/AI choice.

expansive_ammo.name: Expansive Ammunition
expansive_ammo.summary: When it causes the Foreign Object Critical Injury, the victim also takes a rerolled non-Foreign-Object injury, without its Bonus Damage.
expansive_ammo.unit: 10 rounds (bullets, arrows, shotgun shells); 1 each (grenades, rockets)
expansive_ammo.unmodelled: Book lists Arrows, Bullets and Slugs; slugs are a bullet type (p344).

flashbang_ammo.name: Flashbang Ammunition
flashbang_ammo.summary: No damage. Targets hit roll Resist Torture/Drugs DV15 or suffer Damaged Eye and Damaged Ear for a minute, no Bonus Damage.
flashbang_ammo.unit: 10 rounds (bullets, arrows, shotgun shells); 1 each (grenades, rockets)

incendiary_ammo.name: Incendiary Ammunition
incendiary_ammo.summary: Damage through armour ignites the target: 2 HP at the end of each of their turns until they spend an Action. No stacking.
incendiary_ammo.unit: 10 rounds (bullets, arrows, shotgun shells); 1 each (grenades, rockets)

poison_ammo.name: Poison Ammunition
poison_ammo.summary: No damage. Organic targets hit roll Resist Torture/Drugs DV13 or take 2d6 straight to HP; armour untouched.
poison_ammo.unit: 10 rounds (bullets, arrows, shotgun shells); 1 each (grenades, rockets)

rubber_ammo.name: Rubber Ammunition
rubber_ammo.summary: Never causes Critical Injuries or ablates armour; a hit that would drop a target above 1 HP below 0 leaves them at 1 HP.
rubber_ammo.unit: 10 rounds (bullets, arrows, shotgun shells); 1 each (grenades, rockets)
rubber_ammo.unmodelled: Book lists Arrows, Bullets and Slugs; slugs are a bullet type (p344). Non-lethal floor only applies to targets above 1 HP.

sleep_ammo.name: Sleep Ammunition
sleep_ammo.summary: No damage. Organic targets hit roll Resist Torture/Drugs DV13 or fall Prone and Unconscious for a minute, until damaged or touched awake.
sleep_ammo.unit: 10 rounds (bullets, arrows, shotgun shells); 1 each (grenades, rockets)

smart_ammo.name: Smart Ammunition
smart_ammo.summary: Needs Targeting Scope cyberware or won't fire. A single-shot miss by 4 or less re-rolls once: d10 + 10 (+LUCK) vs the same DV.
smart_ammo.unit: 10 rounds (bullets, arrows, shotgun shells); 1 each (grenades, rockets)
smart_ammo.unmodelled: A target able to dodge bullets may dodge the second chance as normal.

smoke_ammo.name: Smoke Ammunition
smoke_ammo.summary: On impact, fills a 10 m x 10 m area with smoke for a minute; tasks through smoke typically take -4.
smoke_ammo.unit: 10 rounds (bullets, arrows, shotgun shells); 1 each (grenades, rockets)
smoke_ammo.unmodelled: Smoke does not damage; 10 m square = 5x5 grid squares (1 square = 2 m).

teargas_ammo.name: Teargas Ammunition
teargas_ammo.summary: No damage. Targets with organic eyes roll Resist Torture/Drugs DV13 or suffer Damaged Eye for a minute, no Bonus Damage.
teargas_ammo.unit: 10 rounds (bullets, arrows, shotgun shells); 1 each (grenades, rockets)

bulletproof_shield.name: Bulletproof Shield
bulletproof_shield.summary: Clear polycarbonate hand shield: portable cover that soaks a whole attack into its HP.
bulletproof_shield.unmodelled: Interpose only vs an attacker you can see. At 0 HP it is destroyed (repairable) but stays in hand until dropped (Action).

human_shield.name: Human Shield (Corpse)
human_shield.summary: Grappled foe held as cover; becomes a meat shield with HP equal to its BODY once dead.
human_shield.unmodelled: Live shield: equip as Action from a Grapple you lead; it takes hits as a normal target and can't dodge; release is free. Corpse drop costs an Action.

agent.name: Agent
agent.summary: Learning-AI smartphone that runs your calls, schedule, shopping and navigation; nearly everyone carries one.
agent.unmodelled: Wardrobe & Style +2 only while wearing the outfits it picks (seasonal). Phone/records/data-pool roles are narrative; could gate in-mission comms.

airhypo.name: Airhypo
airhypo.summary: Compressed-air injector: dose a willing ally as an Action, or a foe with a Melee attack instead of damage.
airhypo.unmodelled: Needs drug doses (p.357). Melee hit delivers one dose instead of damage.

anti_smog_mask.name: Anti-Smog Breathing Mask
anti_smog_mask.summary: Filter mask; wearer ignores toxic gases, fumes and other inhaled hazards.
anti_smog_mask.unmodelled: Teargas (p.347) hits meat eyes, not lungs, so RAW the mask does not stop it; smoke still obscures vision.

audio_recorder.name: Audio Recorder
audio_recorder.summary: Records about 24 hours of sound onto one memory chip.

ear_protectors.name: Auto Level Dampening Ear Protectors
ear_protectors.summary: Compact earwear; wearer is immune to deafening noise effects such as flashbangs.
ear_protectors.unmodelled: Blocks the Damaged Ear half of a Flashbang (p.346) and the Shrieker's self-inflicted Damaged Ear (p.349); Damaged Eye still applies.

binoculars.name: Binoculars
binoculars.summary: Handheld optics magnifying the view two to three times.
binoculars.unmodelled: Book gives no rules number; game could cut long-range observation/Perception penalties while used.

braindance_viewer.name: Braindance Viewer
braindance_viewer.summary: Rig for playing braindance recordings: relive someone else's full sensory and emotional experience.
braindance_viewer.unmodelled: Narrative; could tie to braindance-recovery gig objectives or downtime.

bug_detector.name: Bug Detector
bug_detector.summary: Beeps when within 2 m of a tap, bug or other listening device.
bug_detector.unmodelled: Could reveal hidden bugs/surveillance objects on the map within 1 square.

carryall.name: Carryall
carryall.summary: Ripstop nylon bag, from messenger size up to a near body-sized duffel.
carryall.unmodelled: No rules; could add inventory/loot capacity.

chemical_analyzer.name: Chemical Analyzer
chemical_analyzer.summary: Identifies a substance's exact composition as an Action against a large sample database.
chemical_analyzer.unmodelled: Could identify drugs/poisons/loot or reveal a contaminated-supply objective.

computer.name: Computer
computer.summary: Laptop or desktop for writing and browsing the Data Pool.

cryopump.name: Cryopump
cryopump.summary: Briefcase body-bag pump: puts a dying patient in stasis, halting Death Saves for up to a week. Medtech only.
cryopump.unmodelled: Target must be willing or unconscious; one human-size target; surgery/stabilisation in stasis is safer (no number). Medtech Cryosystem Operation ranks raise charges (p.150).

cryotank.name: Cryotank
cryotank.summary: Person-sized stasis tank; occupant stays unconscious indefinitely but heals at double rate. Medtech only.
cryotank.unmodelled: Base/med-bay fixture rather than field kit. 'Medical Tech Check' is the Medtech Medicine ability, not a skills.json id.

cyberdeck_poor.name: Cyberdeck (Poor Quality)
cyberdeck_poor.summary: Modular netrunning platform with 5 slots for Programs and Hardware.
cyberdeck_poor.unmodelled: Netrunning per p.195; the repo's net code owns the deck model.

cyberdeck_standard.name: Cyberdeck (Standard Quality)
cyberdeck_standard.summary: Modular netrunning platform with 7 slots for Programs and Hardware.
cyberdeck_standard.unmodelled: Netrunning per p.195; the repo's net code owns the deck model.

cyberdeck_excellent.name: Cyberdeck (Excellent Quality)
cyberdeck_excellent.summary: Modular netrunning platform with 9 slots for Programs and Hardware.
cyberdeck_excellent.unmodelled: Netrunning per p.195; the repo's net code owns the deck model.

disposable_cell_phone.name: Disposable Cell Phone
disposable_cell_phone.summary: Cheap throwaway phone for people who don't want to be traced.
disposable_cell_phone.unmodelled: Narrative; could reduce trace/heat on comms-dependent gigs.

drum_synthesizer.name: Drum Synthesizer
drum_synthesizer.summary: Linked pads and processor imitating nearly any drum; needs an amplifier.

duct_tape.name: Duct Tape
duct_tape.summary: Tape in many colours, including a self-glowing kind used to mark tunnels and caches.
duct_tape.unmodelled: Narrative; could mark routes or improvise gags/restraints.

electric_guitar.name: Electric Guitar or another Instrument
electric_guitar.summary: Any instrument; electronic ones need an amplifier to be heard.
electric_guitar.unmodelled: Rockerboy performance flavour; electric versions need pocket_amplifier.

flashlight.name: Flashlight
flashlight.summary: Rechargeable torch with a 100 m beam lasting about 10 hours a charge.
flashlight.unmodelled: Could cancel darkness penalties (p.130) along a beam; also reveals the holder.

food_stick.name: Food Stick
food_stick.summary: Grainy dried ration bar; one awful meal.

glow_paint.name: Glow Paint
glow_paint.summary: Spray can of glow-in-the-dark paint for markers, art and tags.
glow_paint.unmodelled: Narrative; route marking or gang tagging.

glow_stick.name: Glow Stick
glow_stick.summary: Single-use light tube lighting a 4 m area for up to 10 hours.
glow_stick.unmodelled: Could be thrown to light a 2-square area.

grapple_gun.name: Grapple Gun
grapple_gun.summary: Rocket grapple fixing to thick cover within 30 m; climb the line at no movement penalty. Not a weapon.
grapple_gun.unmodelled: Line holds only 2x the user's weight; hand is occupied; can't be used to Grab. Auto-succeeds the fall-save (p.181, p.215).

handcuffs.name: Handcuffs
handcuffs.summary: Basic restraints; anyone with BODY above 10 snaps them easily.
handcuffs.unmodelled: Could support capture/extraction objectives; applying them has no stated action cost.

homing_tracer.name: Homing Tracer
homing_tracer.summary: Receiver tracking a linked button-sized tag up to a mile away; one tag included.
homing_tracer.unmodelled: Spare tags 50eb. Could drive tail/track-the-target gig objectives.

inflatable_bed.name: Inflatable Bed & Sleep-bag
inflatable_bed.summary: Self-inflating mattress and thin sleeping bag folding into a small square pack.

kibble_pack.name: Kibble Pack
kibble_pack.summary: Foil pack of pet-food-like cereal; one numbered meal.

linear_frame_beta.name: Linear Frame ß (Beta)
linear_frame_beta.summary: Powered exoskeleton raising BODY to 14 while plugged in; HP and Death Save unchanged.
linear_frame_beta.unmodelled: Raises BODY to 14 (won't exceed 14). Unlocks BODY 11+ heavy weapons (p.349), thick-cover moving (p.182).

linear_frame_sigma.name: Linear Frame ∑ (Sigma)
linear_frame_sigma.summary: Powered exoskeleton raising BODY to 12 while plugged in; HP and Death Save unchanged.
linear_frame_sigma.unmodelled: Book contradicts itself on plugs (text says two, bullet says one); listed as 1. Won't raise BODY past 12.

lock_picking_set.name: Lock Picking Set
lock_picking_set.summary: Pouch of tools for opening mechanical locks.
lock_picking_set.unmodelled: No listed bonus; without tools a Pick Lock check takes the -2 'no right tools' modifier (p.130).

medscanner.name: Medscanner
medscanner.summary: Diagnostic scanner with probes; +2 First Aid and Paramedic for non-surgical emergencies. Doesn't stack.

medtech_bag.name: Medtech Bag
medtech_bag.summary: Full field medical kit: staplers, spray skin, scalpels and the rest.
medtech_bag.unmodelled: No listed bonus. tool_for is an interpretation: absence could apply p.130's -2 no-tools modifier.

memory_chip.name: Memory Chips
memory_chip.summary: Thin plastic data wafers of assorted capacity.

mre.name: MRE
mre.summary: Self-heating meal bag; add water, pull tab, hot meal in two minutes.

personal_carepak.name: Personal CarePak
personal_carepak.summary: Toiletry kit: loaded toothbrush, wipes, depilatory, comb.

pocket_amplifier.name: Pocket Amplifier
pocket_amplifier.summary: Book-sized rechargeable amp carrying sound 100 m for 6 hours; two instruments.
pocket_amplifier.unmodelled: Performance flavour; could make a noise distraction.

radar_detector.name: Radar Detector
radar_detector.summary: Beeps when an active radar beam is within 100 m.
radar_detector.unmodelled: Could warn of radar-based security sensors.

radio_communicator.name: Radio Communicator
radio_communicator.summary: Earpiece radio with a one-mile range.
radio_communicator.unmodelled: Could gate squad coordination (e.g. sharing spotted enemies) on a mission.

radio_scanner.name: Radio Scanner/Music Player
radio_scanner.summary: Music player that also scans and listens in on active radio bands within a mile.
radio_scanner.unmodelled: Scrambled channels need a descrambler. Could reveal enemy comms/alarm state.

road_flare.name: Road Flare
road_flare.summary: Single-use coloured flare lighting a 100 m area for an hour.
road_flare.unmodelled: Could be thrown to light a large zone.

rope.name: Rope (60m/yds)
rope.summary: 60 m nylon line rated to about 360 kg.

scrambler_descrambler.name: Scrambler/Descrambler
scrambler_descrambler.summary: Encrypts your outgoing comms; matching descrambler included.

smart_glasses.name: Smart Glasses
smart_glasses.summary: Wearable frames with two Cybereye option slots, counted as paired; one pair worn at a time.
smart_glasses.unmodelled: Lets non-chromed crew use eye options (low light etc.) — integrate with cyberware slice.

tech_bag.name: Tech Bag
tech_bag.summary: Repair kit: techtool, wire and tape, fasteners, plug-in modules, heat torch, prybars, hammer.
tech_bag.unmodelled: No listed bonus; tool_for is an interpretation (avoids p.130 -2 no-tools).

techscanner.name: Techscanner
techscanner.summary: Diagnostic scanner for machines and electronics; +2 to seven TECH repair skills. Doesn't stack.

techtool.name: Techtool
techtool.summary: All-in-one multitool for electronics and machine repair.
techtool.unmodelled: p.355 text duplicates the Tech Bag entry (book error); p.101 calls it a multitool. tool_for is an interpretation.

tent_camping.name: Tent & Camping Equipment
tent_camping.summary: One-person tube tent, rechargeable self-heating pot and a cheap spork.

vial_biotoxin.name: Vial of Biotoxin
vial_biotoxin.summary: Coat a light melee blade as an Action; for 30 minutes hits force DV15 resist or 3d6 straight to HP.
vial_biotoxin.unmodelled: Armour neither reduces nor is ablated.

vial_poison.name: Vial of Poison
vial_poison.summary: Coat a light melee blade as an Action; for 30 minutes hits force DV13 resist or 2d6 straight to HP.
vial_poison.unmodelled: Armour neither reduces nor is ablated.

video_camera.name: Video Camera
video_camera.summary: Handheld recorder storing about 12 hours of video and sound per memory chip.
video_camera.unmodelled: Media flavour; could serve 'get footage' objectives.

virtuality_goggles.name: Virtuality Goggles
virtuality_goggles.summary: Headset overlaying cyberspace imagery on your real view; recommended for netrunners.
virtuality_goggles.unmodelled: Netrunning per p.195; also used with interface plugs to visualise machine controls.

radiation_suit.name: Radiation Suit
radiation_suit.summary: Protective suit against radiation. Listed in the starting gear table and Night Market, not the Master Gear List.
radiation_suit.unmodelled: High-level radiation (p.181) treats you as Mildly On Fire each turn; the suit negates it.

shovel_or_axe.name: Shovel or Axe
shovel_or_axe.summary: Digging or chopping tool; appears only in the Night Market survival column, with no rules text.
shovel_or_axe.unmodelled: No description; could double as an improvised melee weapon (GM call).

fashion_bag_lady_chic.name: Bag Lady Chic
fashion_bag_lady_chic.summary: Clothing style: Homeless, ragged, vagrant. Priced per piece.
fashion_bag_lady_chic.unmodelled: Pure appearance; no armour value. Could feed Wardrobe & Style / disguise or social-access rules.

fashion_gang_colors.name: Gang Colors
fashion_gang_colors.summary: Clothing style: Dangerous, violent, rebellious. Priced per piece.
fashion_gang_colors.unmodelled: Pure appearance; no armour value. Could feed Wardrobe & Style / disguise or social-access rules.

fashion_generic_chic.name: Generic Chic
fashion_generic_chic.summary: Clothing style: Standard, colourful, modular. Priced per piece.
fashion_generic_chic.unmodelled: Pure appearance; no armour value. Could feed Wardrobe & Style / disguise or social-access rules.

fashion_bohemian.name: Bohemian
fashion_bohemian.summary: Clothing style: Folksy, retro, free-spirited. Priced per piece.
fashion_bohemian.unmodelled: Pure appearance; no armour value. Could feed Wardrobe & Style / disguise or social-access rules.

fashion_leisurewear.name: Leisurewear
fashion_leisurewear.summary: Clothing style: Comfort, agility, athleticism. Priced per piece.
fashion_leisurewear.unmodelled: Pure appearance; no armour value. Could feed Wardrobe & Style / disguise or social-access rules.

fashion_nomad_leathers.name: Nomad Leathers
fashion_nomad_leathers.summary: Clothing style: Western, rugged, tribal. Priced per piece.
fashion_nomad_leathers.unmodelled: Pure appearance; no armour value. Could feed Wardrobe & Style / disguise or social-access rules.

fashion_asia_pop.name: Asia Pop
fashion_asia_pop.summary: Clothing style: Bright, costume-like, youthful. Priced per piece.
fashion_asia_pop.unmodelled: Pure appearance; no armour value. Could feed Wardrobe & Style / disguise or social-access rules.

fashion_urban_flash.name: Urban Flash
fashion_urban_flash.summary: Clothing style: Flashy, technological, streetwear. Priced per piece.
fashion_urban_flash.unmodelled: Pure appearance; no armour value. Could feed Wardrobe & Style / disguise or social-access rules.

fashion_businesswear.name: Businesswear
fashion_businesswear.summary: Clothing style: Leadership, presence, authority. Priced per piece.
fashion_businesswear.unmodelled: Pure appearance; no armour value. Could feed Wardrobe & Style / disguise or social-access rules.

fashion_high_fashion.name: High Fashion
fashion_high_fashion.summary: Clothing style: Exclusive, designer, couture. Priced per piece.
fashion_high_fashion.unmodelled: Pure appearance; no armour value. Could feed Wardrobe & Style / disguise or social-access rules.

black_lace.name: Black Lace
black_lace.summary: Combat drug: shrug off serious wounds for a day at a 2d6 Humanity cost, kept if you fail to resist; addicts lose REF.
black_lace.house_rule: Lasts the gig. The 2d6 Humanity is lost on use and given back if the user resists addiction afterwards.

blue_glass.name: Blue Glass
blue_glass.summary: Hallucinogen: user randomly 'flashes out' and loses Actions; addicts flash out off-drug and take it to stay stable.
blue_glass.unmodelled: Flash-out timing is GM-called; frequency varies per person. Needs a 'lose Action this Turn' roll or schedule.

boost.name: Boost
boost.summary: Brain booster: +2 INT for a day, may exceed 8; addiction permanently costs 2 INT.
boost.house_rule: An addict's -2 INT and a dose's +2 INT stack (the book doesn't say). Lasts the gig.

smash.name: Smash
smash.summary: Canned party drug: +2 to social and performance skills; addicts get -2 to the same skills and cravings.
smash.unmodelled: Craving is roleplay only. Addicted penalty has no stated exception while dosed; assumed net 0 while high.

synthcoke.name: Synthcoke
synthcoke.summary: Stimulant: +1 REF (may exceed 8) with paranoia; addicts lose 2 REF unless high, and crave it.
synthcoke.house_rule: Paranoia and craving are roleplay; no game effect. Effects last the gig (4 hours).

antibiotic.name: Antibiotic
antibiotic.summary: Speeds natural healing: +2 HP per day for a week; only one course at a time.
antibiotic.unmodelled: Between-gig healing only; needs a downtime/day clock.

rapidetox.name: Rapidetox
rapidetox.summary: Instantly purges a drug, poison or intoxicant from the target.
rapidetox.unmodelled: Ends drug Primary Effects immediately (book does not say it triggers the addiction roll; assume no roll).

speedheal.name: Speedheal
speedheal.summary: Heals HP equal to the target's BODY + WILL at once; not on the Mortally Wounded; once per day.

stim.name: Stim
stim.summary: Target ignores Seriously Wounded penalties for an hour; once per day.

surge.name: Surge
surge.summary: Target functions unimpaired without sleep for 24 hours; once per week.
surge.unmodelled: No fatigue/sleep rules in core combat; only matters for downtime or multi-day gigs.

addiction_therapy.name: Addiction Therapy
addiction_therapy.summary: A week of therapy by a Medtech (not on self) cures one addiction; that drug's secondary roll auto-fails for a year.
addiction_therapy.unmodelled: Overnight hospital stay 100eb/night (Campaign.treat_addiction models the week, the check, the materials and the year of auto-fails).

fx_keys.no_damage: bool. Hit deals no HP damage (effect comes from status/other fx). air_pistol, microwaver, shrieker
fx_keys.no_crit_injury: bool. Damage from this weapon never causes a Critical Injury (incl. double-6). air_pistol, flamethrower, stun_baton, stun_gun
fx_keys.no_ablate: bool. Hits don't ablate the target's armour SP. stun_baton, stun_gun
fx_keys.acid_sp_ablate: int. With acid paintballs, each hit lowers SP of armour at the hit location by n (no damage). air_pistol
fx_keys.option_slots: int. Cyberarm option slots the item holds. battleglove
fx_keys.equip_actions: int. Actions to put on or take off. battleglove
fx_keys.no_aimed_shot: bool. Cannot make Aimed Shots. hurricane_assault_weapon, flamethrower, rhinemetall_emg86, tsunami_helix
fx_keys.reload_actions: int. Actions a full reload takes (spread over turns). Default 1. hurricane, cowboy_u56, emg86, helix
fx_keys.min_body: int. BODY needed to fire unless the weapon is mounted. hurricane, cowboy_u56, emg86, helix
fx_keys.non_basic_ammo_only: bool. Only Non-Basic ammo of its type may be loaded. dartgun
fx_keys.shell_only: bool. Shotgun that fires only shotgun shells (no slug mode). flamethrower
fx_keys.any_grenade_ammo: bool. Exotic that may load every grenade ammo type despite the exotic rule. cowboy_u56
fx_keys.battery_shots: int. Shots per battery pack; ammo is free. microwaver, shrieker, stun_gun
fx_keys.battery_cost: eb per spare battery pack. microwaver, shrieker, stun_gun
fx_keys.battery_recharge: string duration to recharge a pack. microwaver, shrieker, stun_gun
fx_keys.disable_count: int. Number of cyberware/carried-electronics items disabled when the status lands. microwaver
fx_keys.self_status: {name, unless}. Condition the user suffers on firing unless the named protection is worn. shrieker
fx_keys.smartgun: bool. Weapon has a (built-in) Smartgun Link; its +1 is already folded into attack_bonus. malorian_arms_3516
fx_keys.autofire_only: bool. Weapon can only attack in Autofire mode (no single shots). tsunami_helix
fx_keys.ammo_per_attack: int. Rounds consumed per Autofire attack (default 10). tsunami_helix
fx_keys.jam_on_fumble: bool. A natural-1 Critical Failure on the attack jams the weapon until cleared. quality_poor
fx_keys.unjam_actions: int. Actions to clear a jam (no Check). quality_poor
fx_keys.cost_by_base: {standard_cost_eb: this_quality_cost_eb}. Quality price lookup from the standard weapon's cost. quality_*
fx_keys.max_range_m: int. Hard range cap in m/yds. thrown_melee, thrown_grenade
fx_keys.dodgeable: bool. Targets able to dodge bullets (REF 8+) may dodge it. thrown_melee
fx_keys.no_reload: bool. Never needs a Reload Action (loading is part of the attack). bow, crossbow
fx_keys.recover_basic_ammo: bool. Basic ammo can be retrieved after firing. bow, crossbow
fx_keys.ablate_sp: SP stripped from struck armour per ablation (default 1; 0 = never ablates). armor_piercing_ammo=2; rubber/poison/biotoxin=0.
fx_keys.meat_only: true = only organic (non-borg/drone) targets are affected; "eyes" = only targets with at least one organic eye (teargas).
fx_keys.status.hp_dice: inside status: Nd6 dealt straight to HP (ignores SP, no ablation) on a failed check. biotoxin 3, poison 2.
fx_keys.status.crit_injuries: inside status: critical_injuries.json ids applied on a failed check for status.rounds. flashbang, teargas.
fx_keys.status.no_bonus_damage: inside status: the applied crit injuries skip their 5 Bonus Damage.
fx_keys.status.disable_items: inside status: number of the target's cyberware/electronic items disabled on a failed check (EMP: 2).
fx_keys.status.also: inside status: extra conditions applied together (sleep: prone).
fx_keys.status.ends_on: inside status: early-end triggers: damage, touched_by_action (an ally spends an Action touching them).
fx_keys.foreign_object_extra_crit: bool: on Foreign Object crit, reroll the crit table until not Foreign Object and apply that too, no Bonus Damage. expansive_ammo.
fx_keys.no_critical_injury: bool: damage can never cause a Critical Injury. rubber_ammo.
fx_keys.burning_trigger: when burning starts: damage_through_sp = only if some damage got past armour. incendiary_ammo.
fx_keys.burning_stacks: bool: whether repeated ignitions stack (incendiary: false).
fx_keys.burning_extinguish: how burning ends: action = target spends one Action. incendiary_ammo.
fx_keys.smart_reroll: {miss_by_max, modes, flat, luck_allowed}: a qualifying miss rolls d10 + flat (+LUCK only) vs the same DV once. smart_ammo.
fx_keys.obscure: {size_m, penalty, rounds}: square area of smoke centred on impact; penalty to tasks/attacks through it. smoke_ammo.
fx_keys.melee_mode: weapons.json id of a melee profile the weapon can also attack as. bayonet = light_melee.
fx_keys.mag_by_weapon: {weapon_id: capacity}: replaces the weapon's mag. extended/drum magazine (Clip Chart p344).
fx_keys.clip: bool: a magazine attachment; only one per weapon.
fx_keys.underbarrel: {weapon, mag, hands}: weapon gains an alternate firing mode as that weapons.json profile with its own magazine, two hands required.
fx_keys.ignore_obscured_penalty: bool: penalties for targets obscured by darkness/smoke/fog become 0 when firing this weapon. infrared scope.
fx_keys.requires_any: list: at least one of these cyberware ids is also needed. smartgun_link (interface_plugs or subdermal_grip).
fx_keys.install_time: time to fit/remove the attachment (smartgun_link: 1 hour); others assumed trivial.
fx_keys.vision_range_m: metres of detailed sight through the scope. sniping_scope 800.
fx_keys.attack_bonus_if: {bonus, min_range_m, modes}: conditional attack bonus. sniping_scope: +1 at >=51 m (range band index 4+) for single_shot/aimed_shot.
fx_keys.no_stack_with: list of item/cyberware ids whose bonus doesn't stack with this one. sniping_scope vs teleoptics.
fx_keys.unit_qty: (item field, not fx) rounds per purchase per ammo kind; cost buys this many.
fx_keys.penalty: (clarifies vocab) armour penalty magnitude as a POSITIVE int, subtracted from REF, DEX and MOVE; only the worst worn piece applies (p.97). Matches data/rules/armor.json sign convention.
fx_keys.deck_hardware_slots: int: extra Hardware-only option slots added to a connected cyberdeck (bodyweight_suit, 1).
fx_keys.grants_cover: bool: wielder counts as in cover while the shield has HP (shields).
fx_keys.interpose_blocks_dodge: bool: choosing to interpose the shield forbids dodging that attack; the shield takes all of it (shields).
fx_keys.shield_hp_from_stat: STAT name: shield HP equals that STAT of the held body (human_shield, BODY).
fx_keys.requires_grapple: bool: usable only while you are the attacker in a Grapple (human_shield).
fx_keys.blocks_melee: bool false: shield can't be interposed vs melee or vs Aimed Shots at the head (human_shield).
fx_keys.blocks_aimed_head: bool false: shield can't be interposed vs melee or vs Aimed Shots at the head (human_shield).
fx_keys.no_stack: bool: bonus doesn't stack with another copy of the same item (agent, medscanner, techscanner).
fx_keys.drug_delivery: {willing: 'action', unwilling: 'melee_attack'}: how a dose is given (airhypo).
fx_keys.immune: list of hazard tags the wearer ignores: 'inhaled' (anti_smog_mask), 'loud_noise' (ear_protectors), 'radiation' (radiation_suit).
fx_keys.detects: {what, range_m}: device alerts when that thing is within range (bug_detector, radar_detector).
fx_keys.action_cost: int: Actions to use/apply the item once.
fx_keys.stasis: {stops_death_saves?, heal_rate_mult?, duration}: stasis effect on the occupant (cryopump, cryotank).
fx_keys.cover_hp: int: occupant counts as behind cover of this HP (cryopump 15, cryotank 30).
fx_keys.deck_slots: int: Program/Hardware slots of a cyberdeck.
fx_keys.tool_for: list of skill ids this item is the 'right tool' for; lacking it applies the -2 'no right tools' modifier (p.130). Interpretation, not RAW per item.
fx_keys.negates_climb_penalty: bool: climbing the line costs normal movement (grapple_gun).
fx_keys.free_retract: bool: retracting the line isn't an Action (grapple_gun).
fx_keys.line_hp: int: HP of the deployed line (grapple_gun, 10).
fx_keys.fall_save_auto: bool: no Athletics check needed to catch a ledge when falling (p.181, p.215).
fx_keys.restraint: {break_body_gt: n}: restraint broken easily by BODY above n (handcuffs).
fx_keys.stat_set: {STAT: n}: STAT raised to n while used, never above n (linear frames).
fx_keys.no_hp_change: bool: the STAT change doesn't alter HP or Death Save (linear frames).
fx_keys.intercept: bool: can listen in on others' radio traffic (radio_scanner).
fx_keys.scramble: bool: encrypts own traffic / decodes scrambled traffic (scrambler_descrambler).
fx_keys.descramble: bool: encrypts own traffic / decodes scrambled traffic (scrambler_descrambler).
fx_keys.cybereye_option_slots: int / bool: worn eye-option slots, counting as a pair (smart_glasses).
fx_keys.options_paired: int / bool: worn eye-option slots, counting as a pair (smart_glasses).
fx_keys.coating: {weapon, replaces_damage, dv, check, damage_dice (d6s), bypass_armor, meat_only}: blade coating effect per hit (vials).
fx_keys.requires: {item_id: count} when a count matters (linear frames: interface_plugs); 'role:<id>' for role locks (cryopump, cryotank).
fx_keys.administer: how a dose is given: 'airhypo_action' = an Action with an Airhypo on a willing target, or a Melee Weapon Attack that doses instead of damaging an unwilling one (p.150, p.227). All drugs and pharmaceuticals.
fx_keys.addiction_check: roll made when the Primary Effect ends: WILL + Resist Torture/Drugs + 1d10 vs addiction_dv; failure applies 'addicted' permanently (p.227). Drugs.
fx_keys.stack_extends: true: each extra dose extends the Primary Effect by its full duration (p.227). Drugs.
fx_keys.addicted: fx dict applied permanently once addicted (until Addiction Therapy). Drugs.
fx_keys.suppressed_by_primary: inside 'addicted': true if the addicted penalty does not apply while the drug's Primary Effect is active (Black Lace, Synthcoke). False = always applies (Boost, Smash).
fx_keys.primary_override: inside 'addicted': replaces the Primary Effect fx for an addict (Blue Glass: immune to flashing out instead).
fx_keys.ignore_seriously_wounded: true: Seriously Wounded penalties ignored (same key combatant.gd already reads from cyberware fx). Black Lace, Stim.
fx_keys.humanity_loss: dice string of Humanity Loss on taking a dose. Black Lace ('2d6').
fx_keys.humanity_refund_on_resist: true: the dose's Humanity Loss is given back if the addiction check succeeds. Black Lace.
fx_keys.stat_cap_bypass: true: the stat_bonus may raise the STAT above 8. Boost, Synthcoke.
fx_keys.flash_out: true: at GM-chosen moments the user loses their Action on a Turn (hallucination burst). Blue Glass.
fx_keys.flash_out_every: rough interval between flash-outs for an addict ('about 1 hour'). Blue Glass.
fx_keys.immune_flash_out: true: no flash-outs while this effect is active. Blue Glass (addicted primary).
fx_keys.paranoia: true: roleplay-only paranoid ideation flag. Synthcoke.
fx_keys.craving: true: roleplay-only cravings flag for addicts. Smash, Synthcoke.
fx_keys.medtech_only: true: only a Medtech can administer / perform it (p.150, p.229). Pharmaceuticals, Addiction Therapy.
fx_keys.heal_hp: instant HP healed, as a formula of the TARGET's STATs ('BODY+WILL'). Speedheal.
fx_keys.blocked_by_wound: wound state in which the item has no effect ('mortal'). Speedheal.
fx_keys.once_per: re-use limit per target: 'day', 'week', or 'concurrent' (one course active at a time). Pharmaceuticals.
fx_keys.heal_per_day: extra HP healed per day of natural healing, for 'duration'. Antibiotic.
fx_keys.requires_natural_healing: true: only works on a target already healing naturally. Antibiotic.
fx_keys.purge_drugs: true: immediately ends all drug/poison/intoxicant effects on the target. Rapidetox.
fx_keys.no_sleep: true: target needs no sleep and suffers no impairment for 'duration'. Surge.
fx_keys.cures_addiction: number of addictions removed. Addiction Therapy.
fx_keys.materials_cost: eb of consumed materials, lost on failure (therapy: 500; pharma batch: 200, as item field).
fx_keys.relapse_autofail: period after a cure during which that drug's addiction check auto-fails. Addiction Therapy ('1 year').
fx_keys.keyed_to_owner: Biometric-keyed weapon (Kendachi Mono-Three, p.348): its special rule works for whoever carries it (HOUSE-RULE: sold keyed to the buyer).

kit_rules._doc: What a crew member takes into a gig from safehouse storage (HOUSE-RULE, owner's design): slot 1 holds a consumable (the one item used in the field), slot 2 a passive utility. Used consumables are spent; unused ones and utilities come back; kit on someone who doesn't come back is lost. Item fields: kit (consumable|utility), kit_use (grenade|dose|carried), kit_name (storage label), kit_short (action-bar label).
